title: SQL on FHIR benchmark hook manifest schema
description: Declarative manifest describing a benchmark hook: the worker command the harness spawns and the STATIC identity of the implementation under test. The harness copies `implementation` into the emitted report verbatim. The worker protocol itself (line-delimited JSON over stdio) is specified in the benchmark-hook-format capability.

command.description: argv array to spawn the worker; the first element is the executable. Resolved relative to `cwd`.

cwd.description: Working directory for the worker. A relative path is resolved against the manifest file's own directory (the default).

env.description: Extra environment variables for the worker process, merged over the harness's environment.

implementation.description: Static identity of the implementation under test, in the report format's structured shape; copied verbatim into the report's `implementation`.
